title: Glaring issues and no customer service
body: I really liked the idea of this, and I had a lot of fun sharing the prompts with friends at dinner and through our group chats. Unfortunately, there are a couple of glaring functionality issues. First, there’s no obvious way to restore purchases. I looked all over the app and could not find this feature. So when I re-downloaded the app on a new phone, I could not find a way to get my subscription back. I tried to cancel and sign back up for the trial, and ended up getting double charged for my subscription. When I went to reach out to customer service, both on their text line and their email, I got no answer. Second, there’s no way to go back to the previous sets of questions. So once you get through a full set and it refreshes to give you your next set, you can’t go back to previous ones. Since I was using this app with multiple friend groups, I want the ability to go back and couldn’t figure that out either. If either of these features are available in the app, it’s extremely difficult to find and not obvious for the average user. I won’t be recommending this app and I canceled my subscription.

title: Love this game
body: Flamingo Cards is the coolest card game app at the moment. It's super mature and untamed! Perfect for college party life fun. 1 chose the "naughty and nice" pack to play with my friend Suzy and boy was it a rollercoaster. The prompts were so innovative and pushed us each out of our comfort zones. We were asked to do all kinds of intensely specific tasks e.g. drizzling honey down another's back, sucking our thumbs sexually, telling each other sex confessions - you name it, this card game asked it of us and everything started to feel so risky from the beginning. I think it's safe to say that it both made us feel incredibly vulnerable to say the least, but we are close friends so that helped a lot. Unlike a lot of party type card games, this one tends to be pretty specific with how it wants you to drink if you decide not to proceed with the dare. Sometimes it'll say to drink once, others twice, and everything in between. I can see why this game allows up to 12 players and the next time I play it, I plan to string along as many of my friends as I can.
